sloka: उत्तमं जवमास्थाय शेषं पन्थानमास्थितः ।ततो ऽहं सुचिरं कालं वेगेनाभ्यगमं पथि ।। ५.५८.२० ।।।।
transliteration: uttamaṁ javamāsthāya śeṣaṁ panthānamāsthitaḥ ।tato 'haṁ suciraṁ kālaṁ vegenābhyagamaṁ pathi ।। 5.58.20 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then with great speed I proceeded on my path. It took a long time to cross the ocean.
